title: Smaller. Faster. Further.
text: BHOC molecules are designed to circulate in plasma at a scale far below erythrocytes, with microvascular oxygen delivery as a core scientific focus.

image.alt: BHOC and erythrocyte size comparison inside a microvessel, illustrating oxygen delivery toward tissue in need

caption: Smaller. Faster. Further. BHOC molecules move through plasma at a smaller scale than erythrocytes. The illustration presents microvascular oxygen delivery as a scientific development focus.
